bio.text: Matt Reeves represents Suwanee, Sugar Hill and Duluth in Georgia House District 99.
Reeves is a real estate and business litigation partner at Andersen, Tate & Carr and graduated with honors from the University of Georgia School of Law and from Mercer University.
A native of Americus who grew up in Jacksonville, Florida, Reeves lives in Duluth and has lived in Gwinnett County since 2003.
